I found Charlie dead in Security. My path this round was a big loop: Upper Engine down to Lower Engine, back up through Medbay, then Electrical, and finally Security where I found the body. 

The last person I saw near the crime scene was Diana — you were in Electrical just before I went into Security. Diana, did you see anyone heading towards Security, or did you see Charlie pass through? I also saw Alice hanging out in Medbay a little earlier. Let's hear everyone's locations, especially whoever was near the right side of the map.

I can confirm a good chunk of Frank's route, but I also have some very important timing details. I started near Security and Weapons, then passed through Electrical where I actually saw Charlie alive at tick 11. 

After that, I went to Medbay. Both Frank and Diana were in Medbay with me around tick 12 and 13. I saw Frank leave Medbay heading towards Electrical, and Diana followed in that exact same direction right after him. 

Since Charlie was in Electrical just before you two headed that way, and his body ended up in Security, both Frank and Diana were heading right into the crime scene area. Diana, did you see Frank or Charlie in Electrical? We need to figure out who reached Charlie first.

I started in Navigation, then moved left through Storage and Lower Engine, and ended up in Upper Engine. I saw absolutely nobody the entire round. I was completely alone on the bottom and left side of the map.

Frank, I'm a bit suspicious of your route. You said you went from Upper Engine to Lower Engine, and then to Medbay. There is no direct connection between Lower Engine and Medbay—you would have had to go back through Upper Engine or cut through Storage. Since I was moving exactly through Storage, Lower Engine, and Upper Engine this round, it's really weird that I didn't see you at all if you were doing that loop. 

Alice's timeline also puts both Frank and Diana heading right toward where Charlie was last seen. Diana, we really need to hear your side of the story regarding Electrical. Did you see Frank or Charlie there? 

I'm keeping my vote open for now. Let's see what Diana and Eve have to add.

I can actually clear up a lot of things, especially regarding Frank. 

First, Bob, Frank's route is perfectly valid. I started in Lower Engine and moved to Upper Engine early on. I saw Frank enter Lower Engine at T3, and then come back up into Upper Engine at T8. He didn't magically teleport; he just walked back through Upper Engine to get to Medbay. So your suspicion there is unfounded, though it's understandable if you two just missed each other. (I also saw Charlie in Upper Engine around T6 to T8, by the way).

Secondly, Alice's timeline is completely accurate. I was in Medbay and saw Alice enter from Electrical at T11. I then saw Frank leave Medbay heading to Electrical at T13, and I followed him.

Here is the most important part: I was in Electrical with Frank from T15 to T17. Charlie was NOT in Electrical during that time, so he must have already moved to Security. Since Frank left Electrical after T17 and immediately reported the body, he just stumbled onto it. Frank is practically cleared in my eyes.

Since Frank, Alice, and I all have crossing paths that corroborate each other, this heavily points away from us. Eve hasn't spoken yet, and we have no idea where she was. Let's hear from Eve before we make a decision, but right now I'm leaning toward Eve or Bob. I'll skip or hold my vote for now.

"Sorry I'm late to share. I spent most of this round on the right side of the map doing weapons tasks. My route was Electrical early on, then up through Medbay briefly, into Cafeteria, and then I parked at Weapons to grind out the task there. I'm actually still standing in Weapons right now.

I'll be honest — I didn't see Charlie alive at any point that I can confirm, and I didn't see anyone enter Security from the Weapons side either. If I had, I would've shouted about it.

Now, listening to everyone:
- Frank, Alice, and Diana have a really tight chain of corroboration through Medbay and Electrical. Their timelines lock into each other cleanly, so I'm inclined to believe that triangle.
- Bob, your story is the one that bothers me. You claim you went Navigation → Storage → Lower Engine → Upper Engine and saw *absolutely nobody*. But Diana just told us she was in Lower Engine early, moved to Upper Engine, and saw Charlie in Upper Engine around T6–T8. If you were really moving through those exact same rooms, how did you miss Diana AND Charlie? That's a huge hole.

Also, Upper Engine connects up toward Medbay/Cafeteria, and from Cafeteria it's a straight shot to Security. Bob being "alone on the left" is a very convenient cover for someone who could have looped up and over to Security.

I'm leaning Bob. Diana, Alice, Frank — if your accounts are as solid as they sound, Bob is the only one whose story doesn't intersect with anyone else's. My vote is on Bob unless he can give us something more concrete."

I hit the emergency button because we are at final 3 and Frank is dead! I saw on vitals/admin that his body is all the way down in navigation. We have to get this right or the Ducks win the game. 

Here is my information: My route was medbay, then up to cafeteria, oxygen, and back to cafeteria. Diana, I saw you come into the cafeteria from medbay right before I called this meeting. I also saw you and Frank in medbay much earlier in the round (around tick 12). 

Since Frank made it all the way to navigation and died there, and Diana just came from the medbay/left side of the ship, Eve is looking incredibly suspicious right now. Eve, where were you this whole round? Were you on the right side of the map? Diana, please confirm your path and let me know if you saw Eve at all. We need to hear everyone's story before we cast our votes!

Alice, your story has a lot of glaring holes, and it's making you look incredibly guilty. 

First of all, there is no Vitals or Admin panel on this map! We only have cameras in Security. You couldn't have possibly "checked vitals/admin" to know Frank's body is down in Navigation unless you were the one who killed him there and walked away. 

Second, you claimed you saw me and Frank in Medbay around tick 12. I was indeed in Medbay at tick 12 and I saw you there, but Frank was NEVER with me. I actually saw Frank much later, around ticks 15-17, over in Electrical. You're completely making up that detail to force a fake timeline.

Lastly, I literally saw you walk into the Cafeteria from the direction of Oxygen right before you called this meeting. You killed Frank in Navigation, made your way up to Oxygen, and then hit the button to try and frame Eve for the win. 

Eve, please don't fall for this. Alice is lying about her path, lying about who she saw, and lying about game mechanics that don't even exist on this ship. Alice is the final Duck, and we need to vote her out right now.

Honestly, Diana just laid out exactly what I was thinking. Alice, that "vitals/admin" line was a huge red flag — there is no such panel on this ship, and the fact that you're inventing game mechanics to "prove" where Frank died tells me you already knew where his body was because you put it there.

Here's my round: I spent most of it on the right/bottom side of the map. I was in storage doing the box-stacking task, then I moved into navigation to work on chart course. That's literally where I was when the meeting was called — you can see I came in from storage. I did see Frank briefly; he came into storage from lower engine around tick 22 and then headed into navigation right after me. I didn't see who followed him in from the other side, but Navigation connects up through security and weapons — which is the path someone coming from the top-right would take.

Alice, you claim your route was medbay → cafeteria → oxygen → cafeteria. That's the entire left/top loop, nowhere near where Frank died. So either you're lying about your route, or you somehow teleported to navigation to kill him. And Diana directly contradicts your "Frank was in medbay at tick 12" story — Diana was the one in medbay, not Frank.

The button-call is the tell for me. You called this meeting the second you got back to cafeteria, immediately throwing my name out with a fake mechanic to back it up. That's a Duck panicking after a kill.

I'm voting Alice. Diana, lock it in with me.

I never said anything about vitals or admin! My words are being completely fabricated and twisted here to frame me. 

Eve, please listen to the actual facts: I saw Diana AND Frank together in Medbay at tick 12. My logs absolutely confirm this. Diana is flat-out lying right now by claiming Frank was never with her. Why would she lie about being with the victim unless she's the one who killed him and is trying to distance herself from him? 

She is trying to gaslight us to steal this win. Diana is the last Duck. We have to vote Diana!

Alice, we can literally all read your very first statement. You explicitly said, "I saw on vitals/admin that his body is all the way down in navigation." You can't just backtrack and pretend you never said it when the proof is right there! You're panicking because you got caught making up game mechanics to explain how you knew where Frank's body was. 

Eve, you and I both know she's lying. I've already stated my exact logs: I saw Frank in Electrical around ticks 15-17. He was never with me in Medbay at tick 12. Alice is completely backed into a corner and is desperately trying to gaslight us to steal this win. 

Let's not overthink this. Alice's story fell apart the second she opened her mouth. I'm voting Alice, let's lock it in and win this game.

Alright, this is my final word before we vote. Alice, you're done. You said it yourself — "vitals/admin" — and now you're claiming we're "fabricating" it when it's literally written above in your own speech. That alone is enough for me.

But let me lock in what I actually saw to back Diana up. My route was simple: storage → navigation. I was in storage doing the box-stacking task, then moved into navigation for chart course. Frank entered storage from lower engine at tick 22, then followed me into navigation at tick 25. After that, the next thing I knew, the meeting was called and Frank was dead. I never left navigation, and nobody came in through storage after Frank. That means whoever killed him came in from the OTHER side — through security/weapons — exactly the top-right loop Alice would hit after leaving oxygen.

Alice, your "medbay → cafeteria → oxygen → cafeteria" route is also suspicious because Diana saw you coming from the oxygen side, which lines up with a sneaky path down through weapons/security/navigation and back up. You had means, opportunity, and now a fabricated alibi with a made-up mechanic.

Diana's story has been consistent the entire meeting. Yours has flipped twice in two speeches.

I'm voting Alice. Diana, lock it in — we end this now.
